ms.report:
Dear MR,
Thank you for your feedback and for highlighting these points.
To address your request for clarification, here are the relevant details:
・Milestone 1 Evidence:

We previously included the evidence per your request, and we are reattaching it here for your convenience: MS1 engines scan.
・Milestone 2 Evidence:
・Internal Approved Design Document
・Public Summary Review

Additionally, in Section 3.2.1 of the design document, we’ve detailed the throughput metrics for processing Cardano transactions.
Furthermore, we are sharing a link to the research paper, Appendix B, titled POC Engines Findings, which includes insights from three different engines: Phishing, Datum Overflow, and Token Dust. We have structured the system to allow detection engines to function as modular plugins, ensuring flexibility and scalability.
Regarding your concern about the significant costs associated with this milestone, we understand its importance and assure you that we are fully committed to delivering a cutting-edge detection system for Cardano. Our team is working diligently to meet these goals.
Please don’t hesitate to reach out if additional clarification is needed. We greatly appreciate your guidance and continued support.
Best regards,
 Check Point Team
